title: Partial Math functions return None where JS returns NaN
notes: deka#378 step 2, rfd#40 phase 2 + rfd#13: sqrt/log/asin/acos/pow/sin/cos/tan are typed Option<number> and the emitted wrapper answers None exactly where `Math.*` would produce NaN. Infinity is a legitimate number and stays Some — except for sin/cos/tan, where Math answers NaN for non-finite inputs, so (1.0/0.0).sin() is None.
